title: Rollcall owners file
description: The input behind ROLLCALL_OWNERS_FILE: who answers for which apps, and who asked for a digest. Internal (contacts and app paths): kept by the people who run Rollcall, never in git. An owner without "digest": true gets nothing.

contact.description: A mail address (required to send) or a team alias; each contact once

digest.description: Opt in to the digest. Left out means no
